themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, execution, and reporting.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques designed to help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications specifically aimed at assisting in the UX/UI design process and user research activities.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights specific AI-powered platforms and software used by researchers to conduct studies, analyze data, and manage research processes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research findings, meeting notes, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, skills requirements, and employment landscapes within various industries.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the behavior, impact, and effectiveness of AI chatbots in user interactions, including potential risks and benefits.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or provide guidance on selecting and using various AI tools for research and design purposes.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications for creating, distributing, analyzing, and optimizing surveys for user research and data collection.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's use in analyzing customer feedback, reviews, and social media to gauge sentiment and extract insights.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
